provenance.method: Per station and season: OLS slope (°C/decade) for 1940–1979 and 1980–latest (observed values only, ≥20 valid years per window). Across stations: paired t-test of modern vs early slope, t-based 95% CI on the mean change, Wilcoxon signed-rank p as a robustness check.
provenance.note: Nexus 1.0 is new and simplified; statistics are computed on the supplied series.
